newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil Cenbank sells 196-day BBCs at 2.293 pct.
newsitem.headline: Brazil Cenbank sells 196-day BBCs at 2.293 pct.

text.p: Brazil's Central Bank sold 2.7 billion reais of 196-day Central Bank Bonds (BBC) Tuesday at an overnight call money rate of 2.293 percent a month, dealers said.
The rate at the bank's weekly formal bond auction was down from 2.327 percent at last week's sale, and it was in line with market expectations.
The auction result show that 700 million reais will be drained from the banking system as 2.0 billion reais in 56-day old bonds are coming due Wednesday.
